MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smaller calipers could help me measure screws and washers, so their purpose connects to my recent hardware choices even though I do not need one immediately.",
    "The locking nut assortment connects to my interest in secure fastening, although I would need to confirm that its SAE sizes fit my projects."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printer filaments do not address my current fastening or hanging needs; choosing hardware does not mean I have a printing project.",
    "The thermometer and epoxy require temperature-checking or repair needs I have not expressed. My recent hooks and fasteners give me a clearer reason to consider mounting supplies."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat workshop supplies as broadly interchangeable, while I care about whether an item helps with a particular task.",
    "Several filament options repeat an assumption that I need printing material, without any printing-related purchases in my recent history."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent choices cluster around hooks, washers, screws, and nuts, making fastening and hanging more relevant than general tools or materials.",
    "Compatibility matters: my screw assortment uses metric sizes, so SAE nuts are only a conditional match.",
    "I rarely choose something just because it might be useful someday; even relevant measuring tools need a current purpose before I would act."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my hardware interests but stretched them beyond my current fastening and hanging needs."
}
